merchantId.label: Merchant ID
merchantId.description: The 36-character merchant code from your Zarinpal panel. In sandbox mode any UUID works.

sandbox.label: Sandbox mode
sandbox.description: Send payments to sandbox.zarinpal.com. Turn off to take real money.

currency.label: Default currency
currency.description: Unit for amounts that do not name one. Zarinpal verifies in the same unit the payment was created in.

siteUrl.label: Public site URL
siteUrl.description: Origin used for the Zarinpal callback and the return pages, for example https://example.ir. Leave empty to use the site URL from EmDash settings. It must match the domain registered for your Zarinpal terminal.

successPath.label: Success page path
successPath.description: Where buyers land after a verified payment. The plugin appends ?payment=<id>&token=<receipt token>.

failurePath.label: Failure page path
failurePath.description: Where buyers land after a cancelled or failed payment. The plugin appends ?payment=<id>&reason=<code>.

apiKey.label: Checkout API key
apiKey.description: Shared secret for the server-side checkout and payment-status routes. Leave empty to disable them. Use a long random value and never put it in browser code.

rateLimit.label: New payments per minute
rateLimit.description: Upper bound on new payment attempts per minute across the payment-link form and the checkout API.
